basic_info.description: Welcome to Prime Central Sunset! Built in 1941, this exceptional 2-story 5bd 3ba home boasting 2227sq.ft. of living space features architectural detailing, center patio, beautiful wood floors, and exquisite wood burning fireplace. The interior was transformed into spacious 3 bedrooms 2 baths at the main level and 2 bedrooms and 1 baths at the finished basement. The living room has high ceilings and updated windows.   The updated kitchen/dining has stainless steel appliances and provide access to the covered patio. The lower level has an oversize family room with wet bar. 1 car garage, laundry area with utility sink, and abundance of storage. In 2011 to 2016, the property was extensively renovated with seismic upgrade, 200AMP electrical service, plumbing, heating, tankless hot water system, interior finishes, windows, and roof. Great location: walk to GG Park, playground, nearby schools, restaurants, shops & convenient transportation. A must see!
